a=dir(p)
b=dir(p)
a.append("only-copy")
print(a is b,"only-copy" in b,len(b))

p=property()
d=object.__dir__.__get__(p)
print(d.__self__ is p,d.__qualname__,len(d()),object.__dir__.__objclass__ is object)

p=property()
q=property()
d=object.__dir__.__get__(q,property)
print(d.__self__ is q,d()==p.__dir__())

def f(self): return 7
p=property(f)
d=p.__dir__
del p
del f
print(len(d()),d.__self__.fget(None))

def f(self): return 7
p=property(f)
f.saved=p
d=p.__dir__
del p
del f
print(d.__self__.fget.saved is d.__self__,len(d()))

p=property()
p.__name__=[7]
p.__doc__={"tag":9}
print("tag" in dir(p),"__dict__" in dir(p),len(dir(p)))

p=property()
a=dir(p)
p.__name__="renamed"
p.__doc__=[7]
del p.__name__
del p.__doc__
print(dir(p)==a,"renamed" in dir(p))

def get(self): return 7
def set(self,value): pass
def delete(self): pass
p=property(get)
q=p.setter(set).deleter(delete)
print(p is q,dir(p)==dir(q),q.fset is set,q.fdel is delete)

 @property
 def field(self): return 7
p=C.field
C.extra=9
del C.field

 yield dir(p)
 yield dir(p)
